svg.title: NetQ troubleshooting integration: agents, server, and the three question types
svg.text: NetQ troubleshooting integration: agents, server, and the three question types
Agents stream state into a time-series store; check validates fleet-wide, show reads it, trace computes paths from it

ECMP-aware; not a live probe (ibtracert analogue)

svg.text: 1 agents push state 2 check = validation suite over stored state 3 show = read stored state 4 trace = path computation over stored state
* WJH records arrive only when the switch's local WJH service is disabled and 'netq config add agent wjh' is set (Figure 8.4-1).
